limitations: Pattern screening cannot establish absence of unknown credentials or identifiers.
Deduplicated content is scanned once; inventory retains first occurrence. Git objects remain in the original bundle.

Images receive OCR; binary signature/certificate data receives string screening. Numeric arrays are classified by dtype without treating measured numbers as identifiers. No credential validity tests are performed.
Git reachable refs only; deleted unreachable objects, GitHub caches, forks, external logs and account settings are not covered.
